en.name: NCR 300 - 4 axis NC Controlled Router Machine
en.description: The new concept in numerical controlled (NC) copy routers, this single head copy router has the ability to program X, Y, Z and C coordinates with 4 axis servo - controlled motors. It is used for the processing of slots for locks, drilling handles, hinges, espagnolette holes and opening water drain slot on PVC and aluminium profiles, this means no more template.

STANDARD ACCESSORIES: Equipped with Ø8 x L120 mm cutter bit
2 x horizontal and 2 x vertical pneumatic clamps
Multiple left and right profile stops
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES: Machine having windows based industrial PC and 15’’ LCD touch screen colour monitor
Spare Ø8xL120 carbide, double lip cutter bits
Spare Ø8xL120 carbide, single lip cutter bits
Spare Ø8xL63 carbide, single lip cutter bits
Spare ER16 collets for Ø8 mm of cutter bits
GENERAL FEATURES: Designed for the daily operations on PVC, aluminium and low alloy materials to machine four surfaces of them at the same time
Equipped with servo-controlled table mechanism to stop the turning table and machining the profiles in angles among the 0°/90°/180/270°
Machinability of profiles up to 2750 mm of length by multi pop-up length stops
Machining capacity: X: 300 mm, Y: 120 mm, Z: 115 mm
Profile clamping width (Wmax. / Wmin): 120 X 30 mm
Profile clamping height (Hmax. / Hmin.): 115 X 30 mm
Profile clamping length: (Lmax. / L min.): 2750 X 400 mm
Electronic and pneumatic braking system for detaining falls of head and table
